kb.label: Tata Group internship session
kb.body: A regional info session for Asia, online, where Tata Group talks about its internship and you can speak to the representatives directly. Registration closes 7 December at 4pm IST and the joining link only comes after you register, so missing the cutoff means missing the session rather than joining late. It lands the day after your last working day at Locus, and it is the first named internship route on the board that is neither MBB nor Big Tech. The registration link is in Pre-MBA Newsletter #12 and on the calendar entry; it is left out here because this repository is public.
